Sanna governance — tool calls are governed transparently

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Sanna Governance.

- Introduces transparent governance for tool calls, enforcing a configurable constitution that defines allowed, blocked, or escalated actions.
- Applies governance automatically to every tool call without requiring special tool names or prefixes.
- Supports three possible outcomes per tool call: allowed, blocked, or escalated for human approval.
- Generates and persists Ed25519-signed cryptographic receipts for every governed action, providing proof of governance enforcement.
- Classifies tools into risk-based tiers to tailor governance levels.
- Requires the @sanna-ai/openclaw plugin for operation.
